title: Deployable kanbus-api artifact: published Lambda zip and CDK construct with per-environment layout
description: Chatticus will deploy Kanbus-shipped kanbus-api per environment. Today it is unpublished; consumers pin a Kanbus commit and build kanbus-api-lambda themselves (services/kanbus-api/AMPLIFY.md), and the AWS resources are described as a table, not a construct. Ship: a versioned Lambda zip attached to Kanbus releases (x86_64 musl, PROVIDED_AL2023) and a CDK construct (bucket, catalog table with GSIs, Lambda, HTTP API) parameterized by environment name, with documented per-environment bucket and table naming. Release through CI only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Chatticus (2026-10-20): the CDK construct should take the service principals as typed props (IAM role references from other stacks, each with tenants, provision and delegate_actor) and render KANBUS_SERVICE_PRINCIPALS itself, rather than a hand-written JSON string. One deployment, bucket, table and principals list per environment; all Chatticus environments share one AWS account, so names must be environment-qualified. Include the second (AWS_IAM) HTTP API, restrict lambda:InvokeFunction to the two APIs, and include the archive sweeper schedule (kbs-791a7373).
